title.en: Sushi Express begins investigation after customer finds suspected worm in salmon sushi
title.zh: 顾客在三文鱼寿司中发现疑似蠕虫后，Sushi Express 开始调查

summary.en: A sushi takeout chain has initiated an investigation after a customer found a suspected worm in a box of salmon sushi sold at a branch in Tsuen Wan. Sushi Express Hong Kong said in a Facebook post on Sunday that it had sent a sample for third-party testing, and that it would...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A sushi takeout chain has initiated an investigation after a customer found a suspected worm in a box of salmon sushi sold at a branch in Tsuen Wan. A photo taken by a Threads user showing a suspected worm in a box of sushi from Sushi Express. Photo: johnsonyip24, via Threads. Sushi Express Hong Kong said in a Facebook post on Sunday that it had sent a sample for third-party testing, and that it would publicise the results when they are available. “Food safety is our most important principle. We will follow up, and we thank everyone for their attention and feedback,” the post, written in Chinese, read. On Friday, a user on social media platform Threads posted a photo of a box of salmon sushi with what appeared to be a worm. He said he was at Sushi Express in Nina Mall, a shopping centre in Tsuen Wan, when he noticed something moving in the box. “Told staff, and they insisted it was not [a worm]. I said clearly that it was moving! [They] still said it wasn’t,” his Threads post, in Chinese, read. He said he placed the sushi back and left. HKFP has reached out to the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department for comment. Past controversies It is not the first time Sushi Express has been embroiled in food safety controversies. Last July, media reported that local branches of the Taiwanese chain left cooked rice outside the refrigerator for over 16 hours without temperature control. Nina Mall 2 in Tsuen Wan. Photo: GovHK. In response to enquiries, Sushi Express defended itself without denying the accusations, saying that it uses insulated boxes to transport its rice and a tamper-proof system to ensure the boxes do not get opened during transportation. Last May, a customer at a Yuen Long branch bought tamagoyaki – an egg omelette roll – that was believed to have grown mould. Sushi Express said it “regretted the inconvenience” caused by the incident. In a social media post, the chain said it suspended the sales of tamagoyaki from that branch for the day, and that those with concerns may ask for a refund. It also added that staff had deep cleaned the store and also inspected hygiene conditions at other branches.
body.zh: 一名顾客在荃湾一间分店出售的三文鱼寿司盒内发现疑似蠕虫，一家寿司外卖连锁店已展开调查。 Threads 用户拍摄的照片显示 Sushi Express 的寿司盒中存在疑似蠕虫。照片：johnsonyip24，来自 Threads。 Sushi Express Hong Kong周日在Facebook上发帖称，已发送样品进行第三方测试，一旦有结果，将公布结果。 “食品安全是我们最重要的原则，我们会跟进，感谢大家的关注和反馈，”这篇中文帖子写道。周五，社交媒体平台 Threads 上的一名用户发布了一张三文鱼寿司盒的照片，上面似乎有一条蠕虫。他说，当时他正在荃湾如心广场购物中心的寿司店，发现盒子里有东西在动。 “告诉工作人员，他们坚称这不是[蠕虫]。我明确表示它在移动！[他们]仍然说它没有，”他的中文帖子写道。他说他把寿司放回去然后离开了。 HKFP已联系食物环境卫生署征求意见。过去的争议 Sushi Express 并非第一次卷入食品安全争议。去年7月，媒体报道称，这家台湾连锁店的当地分店将煮熟的米饭放在冰箱外超过16个小时，而且没有温度控制。荃湾如心广场2期。照片：香港政府一站通。 Sushi Express在回应询问时为自己辩护，但没有否认这些指控，称其使用隔热箱来运输大米，并采用防篡改系统来确保箱子在运输过程中不会被打开。去年五月，元朗一家分店的一名顾客购买了玉子烧（一种鸡蛋煎蛋卷），据信该玉子烧已经发霉。 Sushi Express 表示，对此次事件造成的不便表示“遗憾”。该连锁店在社交媒体上发帖称，该分店当天暂停了玉子烧的销售，有疑虑的顾客可以要求退款。它还补充说，工作人员已对商店进行了深度清洁，并检查了其他分店的卫生状况。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to justice, dignity, and accountability. Micah 6:8 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with justice tempered by mercy, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.
reflection.zh: 这则新闻让人想到公义、尊严与问责。Micah 6:8提醒我们，在快速变化的新闻里，仍要以带着怜悯的公义来回应，并学习用祷告与分辨代替情绪化判断。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: In Hong Kong, mourning a stray dog killed in mainland China means walking a fine line
title.zh: 在香港，哀悼一只在中国大陆被杀的流浪狗意味着要小心行事

summary.en: Outside a commercial building in Causeway Bay, one of Hong Kong’s busiest shopping districts, a column of people carrying umbrellas and flowers wrapped around the block. For hours, mourners waited in the rain so they could pay their respects to Wang Wang, a stray dog who was...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Outside a commercial building in Causeway Bay, one of Hong Kong’s busiest shopping districts, a column of people carrying umbrellas and flowers wrapped around the block. For hours, mourners waited in the rain so they could pay their respects to Wang Wang, a stray dog who was killed by five boys in mainland China. People wait in line to lay down flowers for Wang Wang, on July 25, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP. Holding a bouquet of white chrysanthemums, Brian patiently waited his turn to cram into a lift that would bring him to a small Buddhist temple on the 23rd floor. The 26-year-old from Guangzhou crossed the boundary into Hong Kong earlier that day to take part in the procession, which he had heard about from social media. Wang Wang and her three puppies were tortured and killed on June 28 in a village in Jieyang, Guangdong province, by five boys all under 14 years old. Videos of the incident, which have since been scrubbed from Chinese social media platforms, show the boys beating the dogs with sticks and dousing Wang Wang in fuel before setting her on fire. Footage of the horrific killings spread throughout the internet, ending up on social media feeds in Hong Kong and beyond. As billboards funded by ordinary Chinese people went up in New York’s Times Square and around the Taipei 101 skyscraper, Hongkongers have also tried to advocate for animal rights in mainland China. “When I first saw the video I was furious, and now I just feel helpless. I just hope I can send off Wang Wang and her puppies one last time,” said Brian, who used a pseudonym for fear of reprisals. Brian, from Guangzhou, brought chrysanthemums to pay his respects to Wang Wang, on July 25, 2026. Photo: James Lee/HKFP. 💡 HKFP grants anonymity to known sources under tightly controlled, limited circumstances defined in our Ethics Code . Among the reasons senior editors may approve the use of anonymity for sources are threats to safety, job security or fears of reprisals. What he didn’t know was that the funeral had been pushed online less than 24 hours before it was originally scheduled to take place. Now, mourners would only be allowed to lay down flowers outside the venue. The funeral’s organiser, the Hong Kong Animal Rights Association, also pulled out of an interview with HKFP on the morning of the ceremony. Brian was also unaware that the entrance of the building would be flanked by half a dozen plainclothes police officers. Not far from the temple, a Thai boxing gym had also been asked to take down a banner of Wang Wang after the building’s management office was visited by police. At the same time, charities and activists have struggled to get advertisements depicting the dogs approved by public transport companies. In the years since Hong Kong saw mass protests in 2019...
body.zh: 香港最繁忙的购物区之一铜锣湾的一栋商业大楼外，一队人拿着雨伞和鲜花围住了整个街区。哀悼者在雨中等待了几个小时，以便向在中国大陆被五个男孩杀害的流浪狗旺旺表示敬意。 2026 年 7 月 25 日，人们排队等候为旺旺献花。照片：James Lee/HKFP。布莱恩手捧一束白菊花，耐心等待轮到他挤进电梯，乘电梯前往 23 楼的一座小佛寺。这位来自广州的 26 岁男子当天早些时候越境进入香港参加游行，他是从社交媒体上听说的。 6月28日，旺旺和她的三只小狗在广东省揭阳市的一个村庄被五名14岁以下的男孩折磨致死。该事件的视频已从中国社交媒体平台上删除，视频显示男孩们用棍棒殴打狗，并在旺旺身上浇上燃料，然后将其点燃。可怕杀戮的视频在互联网上传播，最终出现在香港及其他地区的社交媒体上。随着普通中国人资助的广告牌在纽约时代广场和台北101摩天大楼周围竖起，香港人也试图在中国大陆倡导动物权利。 “当我第一次看到这段视频时，我非常愤怒，现在我只感到无助。我只希望能最后一次送走旺旺和她的小狗，”布莱恩说。由于担心遭到报复，他使用了化名。 2026 年 7 月 25 日，来自广州的布莱恩带着菊花向王旺表示敬意。照片：James Lee/HKFP。 💡 HKFP 在我们的道德准则中规定的严格控制、有限的情况下对已知消息来源给予匿名。高级编辑可能批准对消息来源使用匿名的原因包括对安全、工作保障的威胁或担心遭到报复。他不知道的是，葬礼在原定举行日期前不到24小时就被推送到了网上。现在，哀悼者只能在会场外献花。葬礼的组织者香港动物权利协会也在仪式当天早上退出了香港新闻社的采访。布莱恩也不知道大楼入口两侧会有六名便衣警察。距离寺庙不远的一家泰拳馆在警方拜访管理处后，也被要求取下“旺旺”的横幅。与此同时，慈善机构和活动人士一直在努力让描绘狗的广告获得公共交通公司的批准。自2019年香港发生大规模抗议以来的这些年里……

title.en: Chinese comedian Guo Degang investigated after patriotic song gag
title.zh: 中国喜剧演员郭德纲因爱国歌曲笑话被调查

summary.en: A famous Chinese comedian is under investigation, local authorities told AFP on Sunday, after he reportedly poked fun at a patriotic song during a performance. The ruling Communist Party maintains tight control over China’s arts scene, and the government has enacted laws in...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自香港栏目的新闻，重点涉及真理、分辨与诚实。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A famous Chinese comedian is under investigation, local authorities told AFP on Sunday, after he reportedly poked fun at a patriotic song during a performance. Chinese comedian Guo Degang. Photo: Kai Tak Sports Park. The ruling Communist Party maintains tight control over China’s arts scene, and the government has enacted laws in recent years to protect national heroes and symbols from purported slander. Guo Degang, 53, allegedly improvised part of a 1956 tune about Chinese fighters defeating Japanese soldiers in World War II during a performance in the central city of Wuhan in July, according to local media reports. The Wuhan culture and tourism bureau confirmed by phone to AFP on Sunday that an investigation into Guo was ongoing, but it was not clear what stage it had reached. Guo, from the northern city of Tianjin, is known for reviving a style of rapid comic dialogue called crosstalk — “xiangsheng” in Chinese — during the 2000s and 2010s. He has performed on state broadcaster CCTV’s annual Spring Festival Gala and at the Great Hall of the People, a grand government building in Beijing that hosts major state events. Guo was unable to be reached on social media, and his Weibo account seems to have been inactive since August 9. The Great Hall of People in China. Photo: Mirko Kuzmanovic, via Shutterstock. Venues in other Chinese cities have postponed perfomances featuring Guo this month and have been offering refunds. The song, “Playing My Beloved Pipa”, was recognised in 2019 as an “outstanding” song celebrating the founding of The People’s Republic of China, online outlet The Paper reported this month. In one instance, Guo allegedly changed the lyric, “quiet on Weishan Lake”, to “quiet in the Forbidden City” — China’s former seat of imperial power — and performed the lines with a “comedic” touch, the report said. Authorities had not approved his riff before the performance, The Paper said, citing Wuhan’s culture bureau. It reported that local authorities were investigating Guo for “suspected violations” of rules on commercial performances. Under President Xi Jinping, authorities have tightened their oversight of arts performances, including comedy shows. In 2023, authorities fined a performing group the equivalent of millions of dollars and suspended their shows indefinitely after a comic made an oblique joke about the armed forces. Li Haoshi referenced a well-known army slogan while joking about watching his dogs chase a squirrel — which officials said had “caused a bad social impact” and broken the law.
body.zh: 地方当局周日告诉法新社，一名中国著名喜剧演员正在接受调查，据报道他在表演中取笑一首爱国歌曲。中国喜剧演员郭德纲。照片：启德体育公园。执政的共产党对中国的艺术界保持着严格的控制，政府近年来颁布了法律来保护民族英雄和象征免受所谓的诽谤。据当地媒体报道，53 岁的郭德纲据称在 7 月在中部城市武汉的一场演出中即兴创作了一首 1956 年的歌曲，该歌曲讲述的是二战中中国战士击败日本士兵的故事。武汉文化和旅游局周日通过电话向法新社证实，对郭的调查正在进行中，但尚不清楚调查进展到什么阶段。郭来自北方城市天津，因复兴 2000 年代和 2010 年代一种名为相声的快速相声风格而闻名。他曾在中央电视台一年一度的春节联欢晚会上以及在人民大会堂（北京一座举办重大国家活动的宏伟政府大楼）进行表演。无法在社交媒体上联系到郭，他的微博账户似乎自 8 月 9 日以来一直处于闲置状态。 中国人民大会堂。照片：Mirko Kuzmanovic，来自 Shutterstock。中国其他城市的场馆已推迟本月郭的演出并提供退款。据澎湃新闻本月报道，这首歌曲《弹奏我心爱的琵琶》被评为2019年庆祝中华人民共和国成立“优秀”歌曲。报道称，有一次，郭据称将歌词“微山湖静”改为“紫禁城静”——中国以前的皇权所在地——并以一种“喜剧”的方式表演台词。澎湃新闻援引武汉市文化局的消息称，当局在演出前并未批准他的即兴表演。据报道，地方当局正在调查郭“涉嫌违反”商业演出规则。在习近平主席的领导下，当局加强了对包括喜剧表演在内的艺术表演的监管。 2023 年，一名喜剧演员对武装部队开了一个拐弯抹角的玩笑，当局对一个表演团体处以数百万美元的罚款，并无限期暂停他们的演出。李浩石一边开玩笑说自己看着自己的狗追松鼠，一边引用了一句著名的军队口号——官员们表示，这“造成了恶劣的社会影响”，而且触犯了法律。

title.en: ‘She’s not afraid of anyone’: the prison writings of one of Hong Kong’s last outspoken democracy activists

summary.en: Chow Hang-tung, a prominent Hong Kong democracy activist, has been detained since 2021. From prison, she continues to write on various topics, including the meaning of freedom and the Tiananmen Square events, despite being found guilty of “inciting subversion.”
summary.zh: 香港著名民主活动家邹幸彤自2021年起被拘留。尽管被判“煽动颠覆罪”，她仍在狱中笔耕不辍，撰写关于自由的意义和天安门事件等各种主题的文章。

body.en: Chow Hang-tung has been detained since 2021, and written about everything from clothes to Tiananmen Square and the meaning of freedom Tiananmen Square vigil organisers in Hong Kong found guilty of ‘inciting subversion’ In one essay written from prison, Chow Hang-tung worries about her hairstyle before court appearances because there are no combs or mirrors in her cell. “In a place like prison, where anything that is personal is stripped away, it’s even more important to hold on to every means by which you can express yourself,” she writes. “Don’t let uniform, depersonalised rules, dress codes, schedules, and behavioural requirements grind down your edges and mould you into a ‘model citizen’”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 周恒东自 2021 年以来一直被拘留，并撰写了从服装到天安门广场以及自由的意义等各种内容。香港天安门广场守夜活动组织者被判犯有“煽动颠覆罪”。在一篇在狱中写的文章中，周恒东对自己出庭前的发型感到担忧，因为她的牢房里没有梳子或镜子。 “在监狱这样的地方，任何个人的东西都被剥夺了，更重要的是要坚持一切可以表达自己的方式，”她写道。 “不要让统一的、非个性化的规则、着装规范、时间表和行为要求磨掉你的棱角，把你塑造成‘模范公民’”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The unwavering spirit of activists like Chow Hang-tung, who continue to speak truth from confinement, reminds us of the biblical call to advocate for the vulnerable. Yahweh's word encourages us to be a voice for those who cannot speak for themselves, especially the destitute and those whose rights are denied. Her writings from prison embody a profound...

body.en: Nasa-funded project uses yeasts to recycle plastics and other waste into food shaped into biscuits by 3D printers Cookies produced from upcycled plastic may sound like something straight out of a dystopian sci-fi plot. But researchers say that they have succeeded in creating such a product as part of a Nasa-funded project aimed at feeding astronauts on future space missions. The technology uses specially designed yeasts to transform plastics and agricultural waste into edible proteins, fats and flavourings. The resulting slurry is pased through a 3D printer to create a disc-shaped “cookie”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 美国宇航局资助的项目利用酵母将塑料和其他废物回收成食物，并通过 3D 打印机将其加工成饼干。用升级回收的塑料生产的饼干听起来像是直接来自反乌托邦科幻情节的东西。但研究人员表示，他们已经成功地创造了这样一种产品，作为美国宇航局资助的项目的一部分，该项目旨在为未来太空任务中的宇航员提供食物。该技术使用专门设计的酵母将塑料和农业废物转化为可食用的蛋白质、脂肪和调味品。将所得浆料通过 3D 打印机，制成圆盘状“饼干”。继续阅读...

body.en: Carbon capture and storage could make the Rosebank site compatible with UK net zero commitments – if its owners are willing to pay the price The British government must soon decide whether it should give consent to two oil and gasfields , Rosebank in the North Atlantic and Jackdaw in the North Sea. Amid both insecurity of energy supplies and deadly evidence of the climate crisis, the prime minister, Andy Burnham, is facing pressure from the oil and gas industry and unions on one side, and environmentalists on the other. Labour’s manifesto commitment not to approve new drilling licences offers little help, because the fields already have licences, granted by the previous Conservative government in 2022 and 2023. But last year, Edinburgh’s court of session ruled that the environmental impact assessments on which this decision relied were unlawful. The Conservative government had, the court ruled, failed to include the emissions generated when the oil and gas from the fields is burned. The court allowed work to continue on the fields, but a new assessment had to be done and approval sought again. body.en: Plastic might be the last ingredient you would ever add to a cookie recipe. But a team of researchers is looking to change that. They've programmed yeasts to turn plastic and agricultural waste into edible proteins and flavoring molecules, creating a treat from trash. The technology not only offers a new upcycling method but could also sustain life in disaster zones or even deep-space missions with humans aboard.

title.en: Nanoparticle flu vaccine protects against three influenza strains in mice
title.zh: 纳米颗粒流感疫苗可保护小鼠免受三种流感病毒株的侵害

summary.en: A new nanoparticle vaccine could one day give patients immunity to the flu with fewer trips to the doctor and without requiring health officials to correctly guess which flu strains will become dominant each year.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

A new nanoparticle vaccine could one day give patients immunity to the flu with fewer trips to the doctor and without requiring health officials to correctly guess which flu strains will become dominant each year.

Mice given the vaccine, developed at University of Michigan Engineering, were protected against three different strains of flu, according to a study to be presented Aug. 24 at the American Chemical Society's fall 2026 conference.

The team achieved broader protection by targeting a virus protein that mutates more slowly than the main proteins our bodies recognize on inactivated flu viruses.

Current flu vaccines must include a mix of three or four flu variants to achieve the same level of protection, and even then, they are only 30% to 60% effective.

"Our goal is to develop a broadly protective and more effective flu vaccine, so you don't have to get a flu shot every season," said Fei Wen, U-M professor of chemical engineering and the corresponding author of the study. "Eventually, with enough effort and research, we believe that you might need one shot to be protected for life."

When we get flu shots, our immune systems confront inactivated flu viruses injected into our arms. The main protein they detect is hemagglutinin, which makes up 80% of the virus's surface . But the immunity is temporary because hemagglutinin is prone to mutation, with 19 versions currently in circulation and new variants emerging every few years .

Because of the variability in hemagglutinin, the World Health Organization and the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention monitor which strains are spreading so vaccine manufacturers can include them in the latest vaccines. But if a new strain emerges, the vaccines may not work as expected.

In 2025, a new flu variant, called subclade K, emerged and contributed to one of the U.S.'s more severe flu seasons in recent years. More than 320,000 flu patients were admitted to hospitals, and more than 10,000 died, according to CDC data. The swine flu pandemic of 2009 was also caused by a new flu variant.

Instead of leaving our immune systems to choose which proteins to react to on an inactivated virus, the new vaccine provides one option: the M2 protein. This flu protein is less likely to mutate because changes can make it harder for the virus to replicate. M2 is very similar across influenza A viruses, including seasonal flu, swine flu and bird flu. However, our immune systems don't naturally target M2 because there is much more hemagglutinin on viruses.

The new vaccine is made of particles that are roughly the same shape and size as flu...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 有一天，一种新的纳米颗粒疫苗可以使患者对流感产生免疫力，减少去看医生的次数，并且不需要卫生官员正确猜测每年哪种流感病毒株将成为主导。 根据将于 8 月 24 日在美国化学会 2026 年秋季会议上公布的一项研究，接种密歇根工程大学开发的疫苗的小鼠可以免受三种不同流感病毒株的侵害。 该团队通过针对一种病毒蛋白实现了更广泛的保护，该病毒蛋白的突变速度比我们身体在灭活流感病毒上识别的主要蛋白要慢。 目前的流感疫苗必须混合三种或四种流感变种才能达到相同水平的保护，即使如此，它们的有效性也只有 30% 到 60%。 “我们的目标是开发一种具有广泛保护性和更有效的流感疫苗，这样你就不必每个季节都注射流感疫苗，”密歇根大学化学工程教授、该研究的通讯作者费文说。 “最终，通过足够的努力和研究，我们相信您可能需要一针才能获得终身保护。” 当我们注射流感疫苗时，我们的免疫系统会对抗注射到手臂中的灭活流感病毒。他们检测到的主要蛋白质是血凝素，它构成了病毒表面的 80%。但这种免疫力是暂时的，因为血凝素容易发生突变，目前流通的有19种版本，每隔几年就会出现新的变种。 由于血凝素的变异性，世界卫生组织和疾病控制与预防中心会监测哪些毒株正在传播，以便疫苗制造商可以将它们纳入最新的疫苗中。但如果出现新毒株，疫苗可能无法发挥预期作用。 2025 年，出现了一种名为 K 亚分支的新流感变种，并导致了美国近年来最严重的流感季节之一。根据疾病预防控制中心的数据，超过 32 万名流感患者入院，超过 1 万人死亡。 2009年的猪流感大流行也是由一种新的流感变种引起的。 新疫苗没有让我们的免疫系统选择对灭活病毒反应的蛋白质，而是提供了一种选择：M2 蛋白质。这种流感蛋白不太可能发生突变，因为突变会使病毒更难复制。 M2 与甲型流感病毒非常相似，包括季节性流感、猪流感和禽流感。然而，我们的免疫系统不会天然地针对 M2，因为病毒上有更多的血凝素。 新疫苗由形状和大小与流感大致相同的颗粒制成。

title.en: UK's rarest bird of prey rears new chicks in secret location
title.zh: 英国最稀有的猛禽在秘密地点抚养新雏鸟

summary.en: The Montagu Harrier successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
The UK's rarest bird of prey has successfully nested for the second year running in the same secret location, the Royal Society for the Protection of Birds (RSPB) has reported.

A male Montagu's harrier, known as "AU" by conservationists, bred with two different females, rearing six chicks across two nests on English farmland.

Montagu's harriers were put on a "red list" of birds most at risk in the UK in 2021. Numbers have declined from a high of nine successful nests in 2011, to no evidence of successful breeding between 2020 and 2024.

An RSPB spokesperson said: "We are doing our absolute utmost to save this iconic species in the UK and are delighted with six flying juveniles this year."

The charity said careful monitoring, in partnership with the farmers on whose land the birds nested, meant the nests were protected by fences to exclude ground predators such as foxes.

The single male Montagu's harrier has also been working very hard to keep his two nests of hungry chicks fed.

The BBC was given exclusive access to the nest and was able to witness some of the spectacular feeding behaviour of the raptors: the male drops prey in mid-air and the female rolls upside down to catch it in her talons.

These slender, long-winged raptors make an epic annual migration to Africa in winter and return to Europe to nest over summer, often setting up home in agricultural fields.

But little is known about the behaviour of juvenile harriers once they leave the nest. This year, for the first time, the RSPB has fitted two of the chicks with satellite tags in the hope of providing the birds with better protection.

"It will allow us for the first time ever to work out where they're going, what migration route, how long they'll spend there, and will they come back to the UK in the first year or the second year," said Mark Thomas, head of investigations at the RSPB.

It is also hoped the tagging can better protect the rare birds from having their nests, on the ground, hidden among crops, inadvertently destroyed.

"This is a species right on the brink, and climate change is not helping that. The harvest here, for example, this year, was like a month earlier than in previous years. So it almost puts any Montagu's harrier nest at the peril of inadvertently being destroyed by farm machinery," said Thomas.

Conservationists have urged birders to look out for the youngsters, and report any sightings by emailing the RSPB's Montagu's hotline at montys@rspb.org.uk.
body.zh: 据英国皇家鸟类保护协会 (RSPB) 报道，英国最稀有的猛禽已连续第二年在同一秘密地点成功筑巢。 一只雄性蒙塔古鹞被自然资源保护者称为“AU”，与两只不同的雌性一起繁殖，在英国农田的两个巢中养育了六只雏鸟。 2021 年，蒙塔古鹞被列入英国最危险鸟类的“红色名单”。数量已从 2011 年成功筑巢 9 个的高峰下降到 2020 年至 2024 年间没有成功繁殖的证据。 皇家鸟类保护协会的一位发言人表示：“我们正在尽最大努力拯救英国的这一标志性物种，我们对今年有六只飞行幼崽感到高兴。” 该慈善机构表示，与鸟儿筑巢的土地上的农民合作进行仔细监控，意味着鸟巢受到栅栏的保护，以排除狐狸等地面掠食者。 单身雄性蒙塔古鹞也一直在非常努力地工作，以保证他的两窝饥饿的雏鸟有吃的。 英国广播公司获得了进入猛禽巢穴的独家访问权限，并目睹了猛禽的一些壮观的进食行为：雄性猛禽将猎物抛在半空中，雌性则翻滚着用爪子捕捉猎物。 这些细长、长翼的猛禽每年冬天都会进行一次史诗般的迁徙，前往非洲，并在夏天返回欧洲筑巢，通常在农田里安家。 但人们对幼年鹞离开巢穴后的行为知之甚少。今年，皇家鸟类保护协会首次为其中两只小鸟安装了卫星标签，希望为这些小鸟提供更好的保护。 英国皇家鸟类保护协会调查负责人马克·托马斯表示：“这将使我们有史以来第一次弄清楚他们要去哪里、迁徙路线是什么、他们将在那里待多久，以及他们会在第一年还是第二年回到英国。” 人们还希望标签能够更好地保护这些稀有鸟类的巢穴，它们在地面上、隐藏在农作物中的巢穴不会被无意中破坏。 “这是一个濒临灭绝的物种，气候变化对此无济于事。例如，今年这里的收成比往年早了一个月。因此，这几乎使任何蒙塔古鹞巢都面临着被农业机械无意中摧毁的危险，”托马斯说。 环保人士敦促观鸟者留意这些幼鸟，并通过电子邮件报告皇家鸟类保护协会蒙塔古热线：montys@rspb.org.uk。

body.en:
Police are investigating the death of a woman who was struck by a car that crashed into a restaurant at Westfield Knox in Wantirna South in Melbourne’s east.

The National Reconstruction Fund will invest $120m into a $240m advanced manufacturing project north of Perth expected to be able to build 2,000 apartments a year once fully operational.

A second long-nosed fur seal is suspected to have died in South Australia from H5 bird flu, just a day after officials confirmed the first death of a mammal on the Australian mainland.

Leah Stewart , the woman who was bitten by a shark at Sydney’s Coogee beach in June, issued an update on GoFundMe yesterday, thanking the community for its support during her recovery.

Barnaby Joyce says a fellow One Nation MP made a mistake on Sunday by suggesting the minor party’s migration numbers would not be much different to Labor’s.

Australia’s unemployment payments have fallen so far behind the pension they now amount to just 68% of the payment, a new research paper released today by the Australian Council for Social Services has revealed.

KPMG Australia is cutting 27 partners and about 360 employees in the wake of an audit leaks scandal that saw it cut off from new government contracts.

The NSW premier, Chris Minns , says he supports extending the royal commission on antisemitism after calls for an extension by the federal opposition were rejected by the Albanese government.

The AFL CEO, Andrew Dillon, says the five players stood down by the Sydney Swans won’t be invited to the Brownlow medal awards night .

Five people have been taken into custody and two have been charged after Victoria police investigating alleged union corruption raided properties including the headquarters of the CFMEU.

Anthony Albanese said there will be “no change” to WA’s share of the GST while he is prime minister.

title.en: China says unmanned moon mission delayed over 'launch conditions'
title.zh: 中国称无人登月任务因“发射条件”而推迟

summary.en: China's manned space agency said Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing's efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

China's manned space agency said Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing's efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure.

The agency said after a "comprehensive assessment" the mission, which involved sending the Chang'e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket, "does not meet launch conditions and cannot take place during the planned window this year."

The decision to delay was "based on the principle of prudence, reliability and absolute mission success," it added, without providing further details on what conditions were not met or when the launch would be rescheduled.

The mission—meant to search for water at the moon's south pole—was scheduled to depart either over the weekend or Monday, according to media reports.

Last week, the agency said the probe and carrier rocket had been moved to the takeoff area at Wenchang Space Launch Center in southern Hainan province.

As of Wednesday, the takeoff site and equipment were in good condition, with inspections to take place and a launch "scheduled for the coming period."

The Chang'e-7 delay comes just under two weeks after media reports showed a rocket launched from the Hainan site had exploded as crowds watched a fiery ball in the sky.

The failed mission involved a Long March 7A carrier rocket, which had lifted off from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, state news agency Xinhua said at the time.

An "anomaly" occurred when the rocket carrying the Zhongxing-4B communications satellite was in flight, Xinhua added.

Beijing has poured billions of dollars into its space program in recent years to achieve what President Xi Jinping calls the country's "space dream."

China successfully landed a reusable rocket for the first time in July, according to its space agency, marking a major step in its space ambitions and in reducing launch costs.

The country is aiming to land astronauts on the moon before 2030, a race in which the United States is also competing with its Artemis program.

title.en: Wild beaver kits born in Norfolk for first time in more than 500 years
title.zh: 500多年来首次在诺福克诞生野生海狸幼崽

summary.en: Pair are offspring of two beavers who mysteriously arrived in Pensthorpe nature reserve near Fakenham in December Wild beaver kits have been born in Norfolk for the first time in more than 500 years. The pair of newborns are the offspring of two free-living beavers who...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Wild beaver kits have been born in Norfolk for the first time in more than 500 years.

The pair of newborns are the offspring of two free-living beavers who mysteriously arrived in Pensthorpe nature reserve near Fakenham in December.

This couple, who have built a lodge on the River Wensum, were the first wild beavers recorded in Norfolk since the native species was hunted to extinction in England at the beginning of the 16th century.

How they got to the Wensum remains a mystery. Although beavers have re-established themselves in the English countryside since 2015, the nearest population of wild beavers is thought to be more than 130 miles away, on the River Stour in Kent.

Some suspect the breeding pair were illegally released by conservation activists, a practice known as beaver bombing which Pensthorpe does not support, said the reserve’s manager, Richard Spowage.

However, he welcomed the arrival of the “very playful” kits, which are thought to be about three months old. “It’s amazing,” he said.

Viewing camera trap footage and discovering the kits had been born were moments of intense joy, he added.

“We initially saw a single young one with a parent, just pottering around, doing little beaver things, chewing on little bits of branch and leaf. And then, in a later piece of footage, it went off … and suddenly it came running back, and a second kit was running after it.”

The kits appear to enjoy feeding on willow and water mint, but not everything on the menu in Norfolk has proved a hit. “One got stung by a nettle, we think, because it reacted really suddenly, jumped back and started shaking its face.”

They are already becoming very independent, and have been learning how to dive into the river and tailslap its surface to make a big bang when they want to scare off a predator. “We’ve got footage of an adult tailslapping against an otter … and one of the little ones is able to do that now, too.”

Although the beavers live in a secret, inaccessible location in the nature reserve, they may expand their territory and become more visible to visitors in the future, he said.

The birth of the kits presents a conundrum, because they will have no mates to breed with in the future except their parents and siblings. “You can’t have just one family in the river system,” said Spowage. “You need a wider genetic pool.”

The reserve is now crowdfunding so that it can apply to the government advisory body, Natural England , for permission to legally introduce more wild beavers into the Wensum, which feeds into the Norfolk Broads.

It will be an expensive project, involving studies of the river system, staff training and discussions with multiple stakeholders, but Spowage is hoping all hurdles can be overcome so Norfolk’s first family of wild beavers can...
body.zh: 500 多年来，诺福克首次诞生了野生海狸幼崽。 这对新生儿是两只自由生活的海狸的后代，它们于 12 月神秘地抵达费克纳姆附近的彭斯索普自然保护区。 这对夫妇在温瑟姆河上建造了一座小屋，他们是自 16 世纪初英国本土海狸物种被猎杀至灭绝以来，在诺福克有记录的第一批野生海狸。 他们如何到达温苏姆仍然是个谜。尽管海狸自 2015 年以来已在英国乡村重新定居，但最近的野生海狸种群据信位于 130 多英里外的肯特郡斯图尔河上。 保护区经理理查德·斯波瓦奇 (Richard Spowage) 表示，一些人怀疑这对正在繁殖的海狸是被保护活动人士非法放生的，这种做法被称为海狸爆炸，彭斯索普并不支持这种做法。 不过，他对这些“非常好玩”的套件的到来表示欢迎，这些套件被认为已经有三个月大了。 “这太棒了，”他说。 他补充说，观看相机陷阱镜头并发现套件已经诞生是非常快乐的时刻。 “我们最初看到一只幼崽和父母在一起，只是闲逛，做一些海狸的小事，咀嚼一些树枝和树叶。然后，在后来的一段镜头中，它爆炸了……突然它跑了回来，第二只幼崽在后面追赶它。” 这些幼崽似乎很喜欢吃柳树和水薄荷，但诺福克菜单上的所有食物并不是都受欢迎。 “我们认为，其中一个是被荨麻蜇了，因为它反应非常突然，向后跳了一步，开始摇脸。” 它们已经变得非常独立，并且一直在学习如何潜入河中，并在想要吓跑捕食者时如何用尾部拍打河面以发出大爆炸。 “我们有一个成年水獭用尾巴拍打水獭的镜头……其中一只小水獭现在也能做到这一点。” 他说，虽然海狸生活在自然保护区一个秘密的、难以进入的地方，但它们可能会扩大它们的领地，并在未来变得更加容易被游客看到。 这些幼崽的诞生带来了一个难题，因为除了父母和兄弟姐妹之外，它们将来将没有伴侣可以繁殖。 “河流系统中不可能只有一个家庭，”斯波瓦奇说。 “你需要一个更广泛的基因库。” 该保护区目前正在进行众筹，以便可以向政府咨询机构“自然英格兰”申请许可，合法地将更多野生海狸引入温苏姆河，该河水流入诺福克湖区。 这将是一个耗资巨大的项目，涉及河流系统研究、员工培训以及与多个利益相关者的讨论，但 Spowage 希望能够克服所有障碍，以便诺福克的第一个野生海狸家族能够……

summary.en: 27 August 1926: Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the...

body.en: 27 August 1926 : Air-pilots report seeing wasps and small green flies almost a mile-high in the sky The report by experienced air-pilots of a wasp at 6,000 feet and small green flies – probably aphides – at 4,000 should make us realise how little we know of the habits of the common creatures which we, boastfully, think we understand. Who would imagine that a wasp could ascend so high! It has proved that it can, but what did it go up for? A certain town-tip that I pass occasionally is a great place for wasps; they swarm over the rags, paper, tins, and rubbish of all kinds, and undoubtedly find much that for their grubs is fattening food in what man has thrown away as useless. Probably the old meat and fruit tins, jam pots too, are mines of treasure for these busy wasps. But surely no wasp expects to find a town-tip up in the sky, nor can it be worth the labour of ascent to that altitude in the hope of finding winged game, though the wasp is an excellent fly-catcher. The mother or queen wasps are busy laying eggs, so that cannot have tempted a drone to seek a mate in the upper air. Nuptial flight may explain the swarm of green flies at a great height; many insects ascend when they are stirred by amorous impulse, and high flight must influence distribution. A strong wind would carry them far from their original home, and doubtless many insect hordes are swept out to sea and trouble us no more. Continue reading...
body.zh: 1926 年 8 月 27 日：飞行员报告称在几乎一英里高的天空中看到了黄蜂和小绿蝇。经验丰富的飞行员报告称在 6,000 英尺高空发现了黄蜂，在 4,000 英尺高处发现了小绿蝇（可能是蚜虫），这应该让我们意识到，我们对这些我们自以为了解的常见生物的习性知之甚少。谁能想到黄蜂能飞得这么高！事实证明可以，但是它涨起来是为了什么？我偶尔经过的某个城镇尖端是黄蜂的好地方。它们成群结队地爬过破布、纸张、罐头盒和各种垃圾，毫无疑问，它们在人类丢弃的无用物品中发现了许多让它们的幼虫增肥的食物。对于这些忙碌的黄蜂来说，旧的肉类和水果罐头、果酱罐可能都是宝藏。但毫无疑问，没有黄蜂期望在天空中找到城镇的顶端，也不值得为了寻找有翅膀的猎物而费力爬到那个高度，尽管黄蜂是出色的捕蝇者。黄蜂妈妈或蜂王正忙于产卵，因此不可能诱使雄蜂在高空寻找配偶。婚飞或许可以解释为什么绿蝇会飞到很高的地方。许多昆虫在受到爱情冲动的刺激时就会上升，高飞必然会影响分布。一阵强风会将它们吹离原来的家园，毫无疑问，许多昆虫群会被卷入大海，不再打扰我们。继续阅读...

title.en: Protein degradation rate helps explain why humans develop more slowly than mice

summary.en: Humans develop at a slower rate than other mammalian species, like mice, but scientists are still trying to understand the molecular basis of these differences. Now, researchers from the Ebisuya Group at EMBL Barcelona and PoL-TU Dresden and from the Savitski Team at EMBL...

body.en: Humans develop at a slower rate than other mammalian species, like mice, but scientists are still trying to understand the molecular basis of these differences. Now, researchers from the Ebisuya Group at EMBL Barcelona and PoL-TU Dresden and from the Savitski Team at EMBL Heidelberg show that across 4,000 proteins shared between humans and mice, there is a clear tendency for protein degradation in humans to be slower than in mice.
body.zh: 人类的发育速度比小鼠等其他哺乳动物物种慢，但科学家仍在试图了解这些差异的分子基础。现在，来自 EMBL 巴塞罗那和 PoL-TU 德累斯顿的 Ebisuya 小组以及 EMBL 海德堡的 Savitski 团队的研究人员表明，在人类和小鼠之间共享的 4,000 种蛋白质中，人类的蛋白质降解速度明显慢于小鼠。

title.en: France links sharp rise in drownings to heatwaves
title.zh: 法国将溺水人数急剧上升与热浪联系起来

summary.en: A government minister says people have been taking risks by going into the water, with 301 deaths since 19 June.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
France has seen 301 drownings since 19 June, a government minister has said, linking the sharp rise in deaths from last year to a series of prolonged heatwaves.

Sports and Youth Minister Marina Ferrari told France Inter radio the number of deaths - a 14% hike on 2025 - was a "tragic toll".

France, Spain and Italy have all been hit by heatwaves that have triggered massive wildfires that have scorched thousands of hectares of land this summer.

Ferrari said people had been taking risks by going into the water, adding: "Many deadly accidents have occurred in areas that are not authorised or supervised for swimming."

She said a number of the drownings were recorded in "open water, in canals for example".

Ferrari said the government was working with regional authorities "to improve swimming areas and make things safer".

Speaking on Friday, she added that "many drownings, particularly among the elderly, occurred in individual pools".

The minister said that sudden immersion in cold water on a hot day could cause shock, and that in some cases "people can also exceed their physical capabilities".

In June, Ferrari warned that too many people were trying to cool off in rivers and canals without necessarily taking the risks into account.

Climate change is driving up global average temperatures, making heatwaves more frequent and intense.

This has been felt acutely in Europe, which is the fastest warming continent, heating up twice as fast as the global average, according to the Copernicus climate service. , external

A heatwave in June saw a nuclear power plant in south-west France temporarily shut down because water temperatures in the River Garonne topped 28C. Under French laws, water used to cool the reactors at the Golfech plant must not exceed that temperature.

Some monuments like the Eiffel Tower also decided to close early because of the high temperatures in Paris during the heatwave.

The dry conditions also saw wildfires spread across France, with Gironde, around the city of Bordeaux in the south-west of the country, being the worse affected area, with more than 200,000 people being forced from their homes in late July.

France has logged 7,300 excess deaths between late May and 22 July, according to provisional figures from the public health authorities.
body.zh: 一位政府部长表示，自 6 月 19 日以来，法国已发生 301 起溺水事件，将去年死亡人数急剧上升与一系列长期热浪联系起来。 体育和青年部长玛丽娜·法拉利 (Marina Ferrari) 告诉法国国际米兰电台，死亡人数比 2025 年增加 14%，这是一个“悲惨的数字”。 今年夏天，法国、西班牙和意大利都遭受了热浪袭击，引发了大规模野火，烧毁了数千公顷土地。 法拉利表示，人们一直冒险下水，并补充道：“许多致命事故发生在未经授权或监督的游泳区域。” 她说，许多溺水事件是在“开放水域，例如运河”中发生的。 法拉利表示，政府正在与地方当局合作“改善游泳区并使事情变得更安全”。 她在周五发表讲话时补充说，“许多溺水事件，特别是老年人溺水事件，都发生在个别泳池中”。 这位部长表示，在炎热的天气里突然浸入冷水中可能会导致休克，并且在某些情况下“人们也会超出其身体承受能力”。 六月，法拉利警告说，太多人试图在河流和运河中降温，而没有考虑到风险。 气候变化正在推高全球平均气温，使热浪更加频繁和强烈。 根据哥白尼气候服务机构的数据，欧洲对此有着强烈的感受，欧洲是变暖最快的大陆，升温速度是全球平均水平的两倍。 , 外部 6月的热浪导致法国西南部的一座核电站暂时关闭，因为加龙河水温高达28摄氏度。根据法国法律，用于冷却戈尔菲什核电站反应堆的水不得超过该温度。 由于热浪期间巴黎气温较高，埃菲尔铁塔等一些古迹也决定提前关闭。 干燥的气候还导致野火蔓延到法国各地，其中该国西南部波尔多市周围的吉伦特省是受灾最严重的地区，7月下旬已有超过20万人被迫离开家园。 根据公共卫生当局的临时数据，5月下旬至7月22日期间，法国已有7,300人超额死亡。

summary.en: Researchers have uncovered a possible reason why the Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 can disrupt the brain long before memory problems begin. In mice, APOE4 increased a protein called Nell2, shrinking neurons and making memory circuits unusually active. That early hyperactivity...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Researchers have uncovered a possible reason why the Alzheimer’s risk gene APOE4 can disrupt the brain long before memory problems begin. In mice, APOE4 increased a protein called Nell2, shrinking neurons and making memory circuits unusually active. That early hyperactivity predicted worse memory later in life. Reducing Nell2 in adult mice reversed the abnormal changes, raising hopes for a new way to intervene before Alzheimer’s progresses.
body.zh: 研究人员发现了阿尔茨海默氏症风险基因 APOE4 可以在记忆问题出现之前很久就破坏大脑的一个可能原因。在小鼠中，APOE4 增加了一种名为 Nell2 的蛋白质，使神经元缩小并使记忆回路异常活跃。早期的过度活跃预示着日后记忆力会变差。减少成年小鼠中的 Nell2 可以逆转异常变化，从而为在阿尔茨海默氏症进展之前进行干预的新方法带来了希望。

title.en: Physicists create a tiny “Big Bang” with surprisingly small atomic nuclei

summary.en: Researchers at CERN have created microscopic versions of the early Universe by colliding surprisingly small atomic nuclei at nearly the speed of light. The collisions produced quark-gluon plasma, the ultra-hot matter believed to have filled the cosmos shortly after the Big Bang....
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及智慧、知识与追求真理。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Researchers at CERN have created microscopic versions of the early Universe by colliding surprisingly small atomic nuclei at nearly the speed of light. The collisions produced quark-gluon plasma, the ultra-hot matter believed to have filled the cosmos shortly after the Big Bang. Even more intriguingly, the particles left behind reveal the shape of the nuclei that created them, offering a new way to probe both nuclear physics and the Universe’s earliest moments.
body.zh: 欧洲核子研究中心的研究人员通过以接近光速的速度碰撞令人惊讶的小原子核，创造了早期宇宙的微观版本。碰撞产生了夸克-胶子等离子体，这种超热物质据信在大爆炸后不久就充满了宇宙。更有趣的是，留下的粒子揭示了产生它们的原子核的形状，为探测核物理和宇宙最早的时刻提供了一种新方法。

title.en: A hidden “on switch” in human DNA has finally been decoded
title.zh: 人类DNA中隐藏的“开关”终于被破译

summary.en: Researchers have used AI to uncover the DNA signature of a key genetic “switch” involved in turning genes on. After analyzing about 500,000 DNA sequences, the model identified the initiator in roughly 60% of human genes. The breakthrough could help predict the effects of harmful...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及盼望、忍耐与重建。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Healthy growth and development depend on tens of thousands of genes being switched on at the right time and in the right place. Specific regions of DNA help coordinate this process, guiding the production of enzymes, hormones, proteins, and other molecules that cells need to function properly. When gene activation goes wrong, cells can malfunction and contribute to diseases, including cancer.

To better understand the DNA sequences that control this process, researchers in the laboratory of University of California San Diego Professor James T. Kadonaga focused on an important DNA element known as the "initiator." The initiator marks the location where the information encoded in a gene begins to be converted, or expressed, into a functional product.

In the new study, led by graduate student researcher Torrey Rhyne-Carrigg, the team used high-throughput DNA sequencing to measure gene expression activity across approximately 500,000 different versions of the initiator.

The researchers then used those results to train a machine learning system, a form of artificial intelligence, to identify the characteristic DNA pattern associated with the initiator. Once the model had decoded that signature, the team searched human genes for the sequence and found that roughly 60% contain the initiator.

"These AI models were found to provide, for the first time, strong predictions of the presence or absence of the initiator in human genes, and were thus able to decode the DNA base sequence pattern of the initiator," said Kadonaga, a professor in the UC San Diego Department of Molecular Biology, School of Biological Sciences.

The findings could help researchers anticipate how mutations affecting the initiator may alter gene activity and contribute to a range of disorders. The study's data and AI models may also support the design of synthetic promoters, sequences that can switch genes on or off, with functions tailored for specific purposes.

More broadly, the research shows how laboratory experiments and artificial intelligence can be combined to uncover information encoded in human DNA.

"More globally, this work is a step forward in the combined use of laboratory experiments and AI to decipher the information that is embedded in the sequence of the DNA bases in humans," said Kadonaga. "Ultimately, within the six billion bases of DNA in each of our cells, there is a gene expression code that specifies when, where and to what extent each of our genes should be turned on or off. If we had an AI model for the entire gene expression code, we would be able to predict the activity of each of the different variants of genes in different people. The new AI model for the initiator is a small but important part of this gene expression code, and I am optimistic that we will...
body.zh: 健康的生长和发育取决于数以万计的基因在正确的时间和正确的位置启动。 DNA 的特定区域有助于协调这一过程，指导细胞正常运作所需的酶、激素、蛋白质和其他分子的产生。当基因激活出现问题时，细胞可能会发生故障并导致疾病，包括癌症。 为了更好地了解控制这一过程的 DNA 序列，加州大学圣地亚哥分校 James T. Kadonaga 教授实验室的研究人员重点研究了一种被称为“引发剂”的重要 DNA 元件。起始子标记了基因中编码的信息开始转化或表达为功能产物的位置。 在研究生研究员 Torrey Rhyne-Carrigg 领导的这项新研究中，研究小组使用高通量 DNA 测序来测量大约 500,000 个不同版本的引发剂的基因表达活性。 然后，研究人员利用这些结果来训练机器学习系统（人工智能的一种形式），以识别与始作俑者相关的特征 DNA 模式。一旦模型解码了该签名，研究小组就在人类基因中搜索该序列，发现大约 60% 的基因包含引发剂。 加州大学圣地亚哥分校生物科学学院分子生物学系教授 Kadonaga 表示：“这些人工智能模型首次被发现能够对人类基因中启动子是否存在提供强有力的预测，从而能够解码启动子的 DNA 碱基序列模式。” 这些发现可以帮助研究人员预测影响启动子的突变如何改变基因活性并导致一系列疾病。该研究的数据和人工智能模型还可能支持合成启动子的设计，这些启动子可以打开或关闭基因的序列，并具有针对特定目的定制的功能。 更广泛地说，这项研究展示了如何将实验室实验和人工智能结合起来，揭示人类 DNA 中编码的信息。 Kadonaga 说：“在全球范围内，这项工作是结合使用实验室实验和人工智能来破译人类 DNA 碱基序列中的信息方面向前迈出的一步。” “最终，在我们每个细胞的 60 亿个 DNA 碱基中，都有一个基因表达代码，指定了我们每个基因应该何时、何地以及在多大程度上打开或关闭。如果我们有一个针对整个基因表达代码的人工智能模型，我们将能够预测不同人体内每个不同基因变体的活动。新的启动器人工智能模型是这个基因表达代码的一个小但重要的部分，我乐观地认为我们将......

title.en: Experimental compound helps burn fat without muscle loss
title.zh: 实验化合物有助于燃烧脂肪而不损失肌肉

summary.en: A decades-old compound may point to a new way of treating obesity by making the body burn more energy rather than simply reducing appetite. In mice, TOFA increased energy use by as much as 18%, reduced body fat without significant muscle loss, and improved blood sugar,...
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: A decades-old compound may point to a new way of treating obesity by making the body burn more energy rather than simply reducing appetite. In mice, TOFA increased energy use by as much as 18%, reduced body fat without significant muscle loss, and improved blood sugar, triglycerides, and fatty liver disease. It also produced stronger results when combined with GLP-1 drugs such as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound.
body.zh: 一种已有数十年历史的化合物可能为治疗肥胖症提供了一种新方法，即让身体燃烧更多能量，而不是简单地降低食欲。在小鼠中，TOFA 使能量消耗增加了 18%，减少了体脂，但没有明显的肌肉损失，并改善了血糖、甘油三酯和脂肪肝疾病。当与 Ozempic、Wegovy、Mounjaro 和 Zepbound 等 GLP-1 药物联合使用时，它也产生了更强的效果。

title.en: How a new era of heatwaves could shake up the school calendar
title.zh: 新时代的热浪如何改变学校日历

summary.en: Teachers warn it could be increasingly difficult for classrooms to function during the hottest months.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Over the past two weeks, the sound of children has returned to Scotland's school playgrounds. Their summer breaks began in late June or early July and ended in mid-August.

In England, Wales and Northern Ireland, however, children will not return until early September. Their holidays are a similar length to Scotland's but England and Wales schools did not break up until late July, something that meant pupils were in school during the peak of the early summer heat.

Or at least they were meant to be in school. While it was 30C or more outside, inside many classrooms it felt far hotter. With no air conditioning and limited ventilation, the heat became stifling and more than 1,000 schools across the UK either closed or sent pupils home early before the hottest part of the afternoon. Conditions were particularly challenging for GCSE and A‑level students sitting exams during extreme heat.

Baroness Brown, chair of the UK's Climate Change Adaptation committee, has warned that "we know high temperatures can significantly impair concentration and performance" of children in schools.

Back in February 2026, Ofsted's chief inspector Sir Martyn Oliver said the timing of the school holidays should be reconsidered: "It's pretty hot usually in May, June and July, just at the point you're asking children to sit down and take an exam… so I think there is a need to have a good old look at it [the school year]."

The recent hot weather has seen some parents join his call. Andrea Bigger, a parent in London, is "absolutely aware of the dangers" of extreme heat in classrooms. She says her daughter has previously suffered from heat exhaustion and was hospitalised after overheating at her primary school. She is "really concerned that the UK is not ready or prepared for this".

And this summer was not a one off. BBC analysis of temperature data shows a clear shift. In the 1960s, the first 30C day was occurring on average on 13 July. In the 2020s that figure has been 19 June.

So, is it going to be increasingly difficult for schools to operate in the summer months? And is moving the school summer holidays the solution to ensuring pupils are able to be taught for as much of the year as possible?

This summer is likely to become the hottest on record, according to the Met Office. Multiple temperature records have been broken with five widespread heatwaves and four consecutive months where the temperature has exceeded 35C. This has never happened before.

June saw one of the UK's most intense heatwaves, with up to seven consecutive days where temperatures were well above the official heatwave thresholds of 25-28C - just as the exam period was in full swing. Temperature records were broken too: 38C was recorded in Lingwood, Norfolk on 26 June, the hottest June day ever measured...
body.zh: 过去两周，孩子们的声音又回到了苏格兰的学校操场。他们的暑假从六月底或七月初开始，到八月中旬结束。 然而，在英格兰、威尔士和北爱尔兰，孩子们要到九月初才能返回。他们的假期长度与苏格兰相似，但英格兰和威尔士的学校直到七月下旬才放学，这意味着学生们在初夏最热的时候仍在上学。 或者至少他们本来应该在学校里。虽然室外温度高达 30 摄氏度或更高，但许多教室内却感觉更热。由于没有空调且通风有限，炎热天气变得令人窒息，英国各地 1000 多所学校要么关闭，要么在下午最热的时候提前让学生回家。对于在酷暑期间参加考试的 GCSE 和 A-level 学生来说，条件尤其具有挑战性。 英国气候变化适应委员会主席布朗男爵夫人警告说，“我们知道高温会严重影响学校儿童的注意力和表现”。 早在 2026 年 2 月，Ofsted 的首席督察马丁·奥利弗爵士就表示应该重新考虑学校放假的时间：“通常五月、六月和七月天气非常热，就在你要求孩子们坐下来参加考试的时候……所以我认为有必要重新审视一下[学年]。” 最近天气炎热，一些家长也加入了他的呼吁。伦敦的一位家长安德里亚·比格（Andrea Bigger）“完全意识到”教室里酷热的危险。她说，她的女儿此前曾出现过中暑症状，在小学时因过热而入院治疗。她“真的担心英国还没有为此做好准备”。 今年夏天并不是一次性的。 BBC 对温度数据的分析显示出明显的转变。在 20 世纪 60 年代，第一个 30 摄氏度的天气平均出现在 7 月 13 日。在 2020 年代，这个数字是 6 月 19 日。 那么，学校在夏季的运营会变得越来越困难吗？转移学校暑假是否是确保学生能够在一年中尽可能多的时间接受教育的解决方案？ 据英国气象局称，今年夏天可能会成为有记录以来最热的夏天。连续四个月气温超过35℃，连续4个月打破了多项气温记录。这以前从未发生过。 6 月是英国最强烈的热浪之一，连续 7 天的气温远高于官方热浪阈值 25-28 摄氏度，而考试期间正是如此。气温记录也被打破：6 月 26 日，诺福克郡灵伍德的气温达到 38 摄氏度，这是有史以来最热的 6 月一天……

title.en: Welsh county becomes global hotspot for carbon emissions after wildfires
title.zh: 野火过后，威尔士郡成为全球碳排放热点

summary.en: The smell of burning from the Blaenavon wildfire was reported 30 miles away in Cardiff.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科学栏目的新闻，重点涉及受造之物关怀与环保责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
A county in Wales had one of the world's highest carbon emissions per square kilometre due to wildfires in July, according to a charity.

The fire above Blaenavon, Torfaen was described as "one of the largest and most challenging" in south Wales in recent years by the fire service.

Save the Children said it was concerned about possible health consequences after data , external published by the European Union's earth observation programme, Copernicus, showed Torfaen behind Malanje in Angola, Spain's Ávila and Annaba in Algeria in terms of wildfire emissions in July.

Torfaen council said it was unaware of the EU data but its own air quality monitoring showed "elevated particulate concentrations".

A blaze the size of about 300 football pitches broke out on Mynydd Garnclochdy, between Abersychan and Blaenavon, with people reporting smelling smoke about 30 (48km) miles away in Cardiff.

Combined with others across the region it contributed to a major incident being declared , which eventually required assistance from the military .

Blaenavon councillor Janet Jones said the smoke had been "particularly bad" on 13 August - about three weeks after the fire first ignited.

"There was great concern about air quality and the impact on elderly people and those suffering with respiratory issues such as emphysema and COPD."

Jones said she had spoken with GP practice nurses two weeks ago and was not aware of any increase in patients complaining about respiratory problems, but added this "could change in the months ahead".

Melanie Simmonds, head of Save the Children Wales, said: "In Wales and across the world, children are breathing in smoke from wildfires, coping with extreme heat and losing the freedom to play outdoors because the air is no longer safe.

"These conditions are not only frightening - they carry serious health consequences for children whose bodies and lungs are still developing."

Torfaen council said it was not aware of the research and "it is not clear what data or evidence was used in the assessment to arrive at the reported conclusion".

It said it "recognises that prolonged wildfire incidents have the potential to adversely affect local air quality, particularly through increased levels of smoke and particulate matter".

It added it "continuously monitors" air quality through a monitoring station in Croesyceiliog Cwmbran.

"While elevated particulate concentrations have been observed during the wildfire period, the council's monitoring station is intended to provide information on general background air quality rather than conditions at specific locations immediately adjacent to the fires," it said.

body.zh: 据一家慈善机构称，由于七月份的野火，威尔士的一个县是世界上每平方公里碳排放量最高的县之一。 托尔费恩布莱纳文上空的火灾被消防部门描述为近年来南威尔士“规模最大、最具挑战性的火灾之一”。 欧盟地球观测计划“哥白尼”对外公布的数据显示，托法恩7月份的野火排放量落后于安哥拉的马兰热、西班牙的阿维拉和阿尔及利亚的安纳巴，救助儿童会表示对可能的健康后果感到担忧。 托法恩市议会表示，他们不知道欧盟的数据，但其自己的空气质量监测显示“颗粒物浓度升高”。 阿伯西坎 (Abersychan) 和布莱纳文 (Blaenavon) 之间的 Mynydd Garnclochdy 爆发了一场约 300 个足球场大小的大火，据报道，在 30 英里（48 公里）外的卡迪夫，人们闻到了烟味。 它与该地区的其他事件一起导致了一场重大事件的发生，最终需要军方的援助。 Blaenavon 市议员珍妮特·琼斯 (Janet Jones) 表示，8 月 13 日的烟雾“特别严重”，距离火灾首次点燃大约三周。 “人们非常担心空气质量及其对老年人和患有肺气肿和慢性阻塞性肺病等呼吸道疾病的人的影响。” 琼斯说，她两周前与全科医生执业护士进行了交谈，并没有意识到抱怨呼吸系统问题的患者有任何增加，但补充说这种情况“可能在未来几个月内发生变化”。 威尔士救助儿童会负责人梅兰妮·西蒙兹表示：“在威尔士和世界各地，孩子们呼吸着野火产生的烟雾，应对酷热，并因为空气不再安全而失去户外玩耍的自由。 “这些情况不仅令人恐惧，而且对身体和肺部仍在发育的儿童带来严重的健康后果。” 托法恩市议会表示，他们并不了解这项研究，并且“不清楚评估中使用了哪些数据或证据来得出所报告的结论”。 它表示“认识到长期的野火事件有可能对当地空气质量产生不利影响，特别是通过烟雾和颗粒物水平的增加”。 它补充说，它通过 Croesyceiliog Cwmbran 的一个监测站“持续监测”空气质量。 报告称：“虽然在野火期间观察到颗粒物浓度升高，但该委员会的监测站旨在提供有关总体背景空气质量的信息，而不是提供紧邻火灾的特定地点的情况信息。” 哥白尼大气监测服务（CAMS）网站对外表示，这是欧盟太空计划的一部分，并提供...

body.en: Leeds, West Yorkshire: I missed it first time as my dad couldn’t wake me up. The second time round, he pulled my toe Dad and I were boiling in the house because of the UK heatwave. So we decided to camp out and sleep in our garden instead. Before we went to bed, while playing catch, we could hear the swifts swoop around our house in the orange evening light. Once it had cooled down, Dad said it was time for bed and tucked me up. At some point in the night, Dad heard something and he tried to wake me up. There was a vixen – a female fox – drinking from the pond, but I missed it. The next morning, Dad told me about the fox and I said, if it comes again, pull my toe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 西约克郡利兹：我第一次错过了，因为我爸爸无法叫醒我。第二次，他拉了我的脚趾，因为英国的热浪，爸爸和我在房子里沸腾了。所以我们决定露营并睡在我们的花园里。睡觉前，我们玩接球游戏时，可以听到雨燕在橙色的夜光中在我们的房子周围飞翔。天气一凉，爸爸就说该睡觉了，并给我盖被子。晚上的某个时候，爸爸听到了一些声音，他试图叫醒我。有一只泼妇——一只母狐狸——在池塘里喝水，但我错过了。第二天早上，爸爸告诉我关于狐狸的事，我说，如果它再来，就拉我的脚趾。继续阅读...

body.en: Whitstable, Kent: I knew that they like bacon to eat so we put some it our nets – and it worked After a long day at the beach in the sun, the sky turned pink and we went to the pier for crabbing. I know that crabs like bacon best and as I lowered the net down, I felt a twang of excitement. When I pulled it back up, there were three crabs clinging to it! I plucked them off and put them in the bucket. The crabs came in different sizes, and most were emerald green and rusty red. They scrambled around in the bucket fighting for leftover bacon. The most we caught in one go was five – in the end we must have caught about 30. I looked in my I-Spy book afterwards and identified them as shore crabs , which come in lots of colours – green, red and brown. They scuttle sideways quickly, and eat things like molluscs, small fish and worms. When shore crabs lose a leg after a fight, they can regrow it after a few shell-moults, ready to use again. Continue reading...
body.zh: 肯特郡惠茨特布尔：我知道他们喜欢吃培根，所以我们在网上放了一些培根，结果很有效。在阳光下的海滩度过了漫长的一天后，天空变成了粉红色，我们去码头捕蟹。我知道螃蟹最喜欢培根，当我放下网时，我感到一阵兴奋。当我把它拉起来时，上面粘着三只螃蟹！我把它们摘下来放进桶里。螃蟹大小不一，大部分是翠绿色和锈红色的。他们在桶里爬来爬去，争夺剩下的培根。我们一次钓到的最多的是五只，最后大概钓到了三十只左右。后来我查了一下我的 I-Spy 书，发现它们是岸蟹，有很多颜色——绿色、红色和棕色。它们快速地侧身移动，吃软体动物、小鱼和蠕虫等东西。当岸蟹在战斗后失去一条腿时，它们可以在几次脱壳后重新长出一条腿，以备再次使用。继续阅读...

body.en: China's "Manned Space" program issued a terse announcement on Sunday regarding its much-anticipated Chang’e 7 lunar exploration mission. The agency stated: "In keeping with the principle of proceeding prudently and reliably, and ensuring absolute success, after a comprehensive assessment it has been determined that the Chang’e 7 mission does not meet the conditions for launch and therefore cannot be carried out during the planned launch window this year." The Chinese message offered no explanation for the cause of the delay from the Wenchang Space Launch Site, located on an island in the South China Sea. Consisting of a lunar orbiter, lander, rover, and a mini-hopper of a probe, the mission was due to launch as early as Sunday on a Long March 5 rocket. It is intended to land at the South Pole of the Moon. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 中国的“载人航天”计划周日就其备受期待的嫦娥七号探月任务发布了一份简短的公告。该机构表示：“本着审慎可靠、确保绝对成功的原则，经综合评估，确定嫦娥七号任务不符合发射条件，无法在今年计划的发射窗口内进行。”中国的消息没有解释位于南海岛屿上的文昌航天发射场发射延误的原因。该任务由月球轨道飞行器、着陆器、月球车和探测器的小型漏斗组成，最早将于周日由长征五号火箭发射。它的目的是在月球南极着陆。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Volcanoes that made history
title.zh: 创造历史的火山

summary.en: Enormous eruptions altered Earth’s climate and societies all over the globe.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及管家责任、供应与公共福祉。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: The first telegram arrived in Singapore on a Monday, sent from the city of Batavia in the Dutch East Indies (now Jakarta, Indonesia). “Terrific detonations from Krakatau (volcanic island),” it reported. Soon afterward: “Stones falling. Village near Anjer washed away.” The wires continued clattering out news of bridges destroyed, boats smashed, lighthouses “disappeared.” By noon on Tuesday, the scope of the natural disaster was clear: “Where once Mount Krakatau stood the sea now plays.” Within days, the source of the destruction was known worldwide. On the morning of August 27, 1883, a volcanic eruption had obliterated two islands in the strait between Java and Sumatra, and most of a third. More than 36,000 people perished, the majority in devastating tsunamis that raced outward from the colossal explosion. Thanks to Victorian-era telecommunications, it was the first time in history that people around the globe could begin to document, in near real time, the immediate and long-term effects of a catastrophic volcanic eruption. What they learned over the next few years laid the foundations for the modern science of volcanology. And it was an especially eye-opening lesson in how the biggest eruptions can influence climate, agriculture, and even the course of human history. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 第一份电报于周一抵达新加坡，是从荷属东印度群岛的巴达维亚市（现印度尼西亚雅加达）发出的。报道称，“喀拉喀托（火山岛）发生了可怕的爆炸。”不久之后：“石头落下。安杰尔附近的村庄被冲走了。”电线继续发出有关桥梁被毁、船只被撞、灯塔“消失”的消息。到周二中午，自然灾害的范围已经很清楚了：“喀拉喀托山曾经矗立的地方现在变成了大海。”几天之内，破坏的根源就被全世界所知。 1883 年 8 月 27 日早晨，火山喷发摧毁了爪哇和苏门答腊之间海峡的两个岛屿，以及第三个岛屿的大部分。超过 36,000 人丧生，其中大部分死于巨大爆炸引发的毁灭性海啸。得益于维多利亚时代的电信技术，这是历史上第一次，世界各地的人们可以开始近乎实时地记录灾难性火山喷发的直接和长期影响。他们在接下来几年中学到的知识为现代火山学科学奠定了基础。这是一次特别令人大开眼界的教训，让我们了解到最大规模的火山喷发如何影响气候、农业，甚至人类历史的进程。阅读全文 评论

title.en: Putting mice into hibernation causes a major loss of synapses
title.zh: 让小鼠冬眠会导致突触大量丧失

summary.en: Hibernation cuts down on synapses, but mice seem to retain memories anyway.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en: Our leading hypothesis for how our memories are stored is that when you learn something, the connections among neurons involved get stronger and physically larger, and that constitutes the memory. The trouble is that these connections significantly change over time—they’re plastic. “If you compare the arrangement of these connections on day one with the same on day four or five, it's very, very different," says Kazumasa Tanaka, a neuroscientist at the Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology Graduate University in Japan. To learn how a memory that can last for years can sit on hardware that shifts every few days, Tanaka’s team made the shift a bit more dramatic. In a recent Science study, they induced a hibernation-like state in mice, which basically erased the state of more than half of their synapses. And yet the mice apparently have kept their memories. Hibernation on demand Hibernation is a specialty of squirrels, hamsters, and bears, but the neural circuit that triggers it is conserved across mammals, and is present in species that never hibernate in the wild—like mice. In June 2020, a team of researchers led by Takeshi Sakurai, a neuroscientist at the University of Tsukuba and a collaborator on Tanaka’s study, developed a technique to artificially activate this hibernation circuit. This can be done by activating a population called Q neurons in a region of the hypothalamus. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 关于我们的记忆如何存储，我们的主要假设是，当你学习某些东西时，相关神经元之间的连接会变得更强，物理上也会变得更大，这就构成了记忆。问题在于这些连接会随着时间的推移而发生显着变化——它们是塑料的。日本冲绳科学技术研究生院的神经科学家 Kazumasa Tanaka 表示：“如果你将第一天的这些连接的排列与第四天或第五天的相同排列进行比较，就会发现这是非常非常不同的。”为了了解如何将可以持续数年的内存放置在每隔几天变化一次的硬件上，田中的团队让这种变化变得更加戏剧化。在最近的一项《科学研究》中，他们在小鼠中诱导了类似冬眠的状态，这基本上消除了它们一半以上突触的状态。然而老鼠显然保留了它们的记忆。按需冬眠 冬眠是松鼠、仓鼠和熊的特长，但触发冬眠的神经回路在哺乳动物中是保守的，并且存在于在野外从不冬眠的物种（如小鼠）中。 2020 年 6 月，由筑波大学神经科学家、田中研究合作者樱井武 (Takeshi Sakurai) 领导的研究小组开发了一种人工激活这一冬眠回路的技术。这可以通过激活下丘脑区域中称为 Q 神经元的群体来完成。阅读全文 评论

title.en: TikTok to pay $400m to US in one of largest child privacy settlements
title.zh: TikTok 将向美国支付 4 亿美元，这是最大的儿童隐私和解协议之一

summary.en: The deal stems from a 2024 lawsuit alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及公义、尊严与问责。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
TikTok has agreed to pay $400m (£293m) to the US to end a lawsuit alleging its platform violated children‘s privacy, marking one of the largest ever settlements over the issue.

The deal stems from a 2024 suit by the Department of Justice under former President Joe Biden alleging TikTok and its parent company ByteDance collected "vast amounts of data" on millions of users under the age of 13.

Doing so was against the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA), a federal law enacted in 2000. It is the same law that dozens of US states are now suing Meta over .

"Children and parents are better protected today than they were when this case began," assistant Attorney General Brett Shumate said.

Other companies to have paid penalties to the US government for COPPA violations include Google's YouTube, which in 2019 paid $170m, and Epic Games, which in 2022 paid $275m.

Meta is also now facing penalties that could exceed hundreds of billions of dollars stemming from COPPA violations alleged by attorneys general of 29 US states. A jury trial in the lawsuit started this week , with the Instagram and Facebook owner accused of targeting child users and profiting from them.

While the TikTok lawsuit predates last year's split of TikTok's US business and operations from its original base of China, the settlement only involves TikTok's operations in China.

ByteDance, which is a privately held company, was most recently valued by investors at $550bn , external .

Under the terms of the deal, TikTok and ByteDance will immediately pay the DOJ $300m. It will pay another $100m when the government vacates a 2019 consent decree , external with the Federal Trade Commission.

As part of the agreement, the predecessor to ByteDance, Musical.ly, was required to pay a $5.7m fine for COPPA violations and ensure it sought parental consent for any user aged under 13.

The justice department did not detail on Friday any action against TikTok beyond the fine. But the department noted that since it sued the platform, TikTok has "undergone significant changes," including to its ownership, privacy practices and platform controls for young users.

When the lawsuit was filed, attorneys for the US said there were more than 170 million teenagers using TikTok and that the app was "directed to children." Yet, it did not effectively gauge the age of users or get parental consent for use from those underage.

In 2024, former President Biden pushed for TikTok to be either banned, or have the company divest its US operations. President Donald Trump went on to support divestment of the app, which occurred last year.

Its US operations are now 81% owned by a consortium of investors, while Bytedance maintains a 19% stake.
body.zh: TikTok 同意向美国支付 4 亿美元（2.93 亿英镑），以结束指控其平台侵犯儿童隐私的诉讼，这是该问题有史以来最大的和解协议之一。 该交易源于前总统乔·拜登领导下的司法部于 2024 年提起的诉讼，指控 TikTok 及其母公司字节跳动收集了数百万 13 岁以下用户的“大量数据”。 这样做违反了 2000 年颁布的联邦法律《儿童在线隐私保护法》(COPPA)。美国数十个州现在正在通过同一法律起诉 Meta。 助理司法部长布雷特·舒马特（Brett Shumate）表示：“与此案开始时相比，今天的儿童和家长受到了更好的保护。” 其他因违反 COPPA 行为而向美国政府支付罚款的公司包括谷歌旗下的 YouTube（2019 年支付了 1.7 亿美元）和 Epic Games（2022 年支付了 2.75 亿美元）。 美国 29 个州总检察长指控 Meta 因违反 COPPA 规定而面临可能超过数千亿美元的处罚。该诉讼的陪审团审判于本周开始，Instagram 和 Facebook 所有者被指控针对儿童用户并从中获利。 虽然 TikTok 诉讼早于去年 TikTok 的美国业务和业务从其原来的中国基地剥离出来，但和解协议仅涉及 TikTok 在中国的业务。 字节跳动是一家私营公司，最近投资者的外部估值为 5500 亿美元。 根据交易条款，TikTok 和字节跳动将立即向司法部支付 3 亿美元。当政府撤销 2019 年联邦贸易委员会的同意令时，它将再支付 1 亿美元。 作为协议的一部分，字节跳动的前身 Musical.ly 需要因违反 COPPA 规定而支付 570 万美元的罚款，并确保其为所有 13 岁以下的用户征求家长的同意。 周五，除了罚款之外，司法部没有详细说明针对 TikTok 采取的任何行动。但该部门指出，自起诉该平台以来，TikTok“经历了重大变化”，包括其所有权、隐私做法和对年轻用户的平台控制。 提起诉讼时，美国律师表示，有超过 1.7 亿青少年使用 TikTok，并且该应用程序“针对儿童”。然而，它并没有有效地衡量用户的年龄，也没有获得未成年人使用的父母同意。 2024 年，前总统拜登推动禁止 TikTok，或者让该公司剥离其美国业务。唐纳德·特朗普总统继续支持去年撤资该应用程序。 其美国业务目前由一个投资者财团持有 81% 的股份，而字节跳动则保留 19% 的股份。

title.en: How landscape gardening is being electrified
title.zh: 园林景观如何电气化

summary.en: The switch to quieter electric equipment is not going as fast as some would like.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自科技栏目的新闻，重点涉及和平与克制。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Part of the soundtrack to a day in southern California is the drone of petrol-powered gardening equipment.

Noise is one of the main reasons that cities around the US , external are banning petrol landscaping tools or encouraging electric alternatives.

These alternatives have the additional benefits of reducing carbon emissions, vibrations and the exposure of landscapers to pollution.

In addition they can mean longer working hours, as they can be used at times when residents demand quiet.

Today, I'm taking part in training run by the American Green Zone Alliance (AGZA), an organisation supporting the transition towards electric landscaping equipment.

To my surprise, the electric backpack leaf blower I strap on is not much heavier than my normal rucksack. Using the blower to herd balls around the park feels fairly intuitive, though naturally I'm much clumsier and slower than the pro landscapers.

As for noise, there's still a buzz, but the sound is higher-pitched and not quite so loud as the familiar petrol-powered machines.

The move to electric power is attracting new companies to the market for gardening kit.

US aerospace start-up Whisper Aero is one of those firms. Its main business is electric propulsion systems for aircraft.

But in 2022, after the Covid-19 pandemic made many people more sensitive to noise, and following a couple of years of research and development, the company realised that its aerospace-grade fans would work well in leaf blowers.

"Our technology is cleaner, quieter and more efficient than other air-moving technologies that exist today," according to Andrew Terajewicz, Whisper Aero's director of air management. "And the leaf blower is the perfect mix of this."

The company has had to scale up its manufacturing volume in its expansion to consumer technology.

Online pre-orders of Whisper Aero's handheld leaf blower started this year. It's priced at the high-end of electric leaf blowers, which are often more expensive than traditional petrol versions.

"It is so ultra quiet yet powerful, that the brain has a hard time understanding what's happening," says Dan Mabe, the former landscaper who founded AGZA.

Whisper Aero aims to further develop its products, including a backpack leaf blower that would be better suited to professional landscapers.

Even with innovation like that, petrol-powered machines are unlikely to disappear anytime soon, particularly for professional landscapers.

For a start, petrol machines are much more powerful, which makes for quicker work, so less time is spent lugging around heavy equipment.

Terajewicz says that heavy-duty petrol backpack blowers can reach a maximum blowing force of about 50 newtons.
